correctness.rationale: Because the graphs have 2t vertices, size-t matchings are precisely perfect matchings. Direct cycle alternating parity gives A,B; the first same-parity chord belongs to none, becoming a cone vertex. Two opposite-parity-class chords must occur together and force unique residual matching T, so final minimal nonfaces are A,B,T∪{x,y}. The final complex splits as ∂Δ^B*L. For t=2, L=S¹ directly; for t≥3, L is a union of two contractible simplicial complexes intersecting in S^{t-2}, hence L≃S^{t-1} by cofibration homotopy pushout and final NM≃S^{2t-2}. Independent perfect-matching enumeration through t=9 agrees with the all-t structural argument; finite checks are not the proof.
